title: A Trap fused into a Unit stays quiet, and a copier's targeting cost is its copied text's
notes: R2226000, R1020: a Trap's or Field Trap's text fused into a card that stands in a unit zone and is no trap never fires from there, whatever fused it (饕餮, an Equip, a Starship Piece's copy in its Dormant Starship), where the engine queued it as a unit's trigger without its condition and 饕餮 holding Wormhole countered and recast its own controller's Spell for ever. R1850000: a copier's targeting cost is read from the text it runs, so a fused Paul Allen's Ghost and Tnack Trav that copied Nature Titan no longer panics on a discard number Titan never declares. The classifier shows Big D-fender (core-001), Tnack Trav (stinkyscape-020), Beam v3 and Repeater v3 (stinkyscape-050, 051), Miner v1 and Miner v4 (stinkyscape-062, 065), Ozark (stinkyscape-078), Phalanx (stinkyscape-082), Spacerace Stimulus (stinkyscape-131) and the Stinkyscape tokens' family (stinkyscape-t) playing differently; that family is claimed through the Dormant Starship (stinkyscape-t-dormant-starship), the token a Starship Piece's fused text stands in.

player.title: A Trap fused into a Unit stays quiet
